title: Card-Holder Reduction on the Pocketwire Personal Account Renewal Plan Fee
content:
Holders of a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card on the higher card tiers pay a reduced monthly renewal plan fee on their Pocketwire Personal Account.

The debit-card reduction on the renewal plan fee reads the tier of the customer's Pocketwire debit card in active or locked status: 10 percent on Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit or Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit, 5 percent on Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit or Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit, and 0 percent on any other tier or with no such card. The tier is read from a card in active status, and from a card in locked status when no card is active.

| Pocketwire Visa Debit Card tier (card active or locked) | Reduction |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 0 percent |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 5 percent |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 5 percent |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 10 percent |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 10 percent |
| No card in active or locked status | 0 percent |

**Points of judgement**

- A Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit card that is locked still earns 10 percent.
- A Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit card in a status other than active or locked does not count; with no other card in active or locked status the reduction is 0 percent.
